semiconductor_relevance: High — Arcadia Engineering Services provides specialized equipment and services for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in wet etch and cleaning applications.
summary: Arcadia Engineering Services Pte Ltd specializes in supplying used semiconductor manufacturing equipment and engineering services, focusing on legacy wet etch and cleaning applications. The company is a key provider of equipment, consumables, spare parts, and upgrades for legacy SEZ (LAM Research) equipment, ensuring high-quality standards and extending the life of customers' equipment.
capabilities: Supply of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Engineering services for legacy wet etch and cleaning applications
Repairs of Combined Drive & Elevating Units for SEZ equipment
Provision of consumables and spare parts for LAM-SEZ equipment
